_note: Prices are ILLUSTRATIVE demo prices in INR, not live retail prices. Emission factors are NOT typed here: each mapped product points to an entity in data/raw/owid_food_emissions_supply_chain.csv and the factor is computed from that file at seed time.

sources.name: Our World in Data: Greenhouse gas emissions across the food supply chain
sources.dataset_name: Poore, J. & Nemecek, T. (2018). Reducing food's environmental impacts through producers and consumers. Science 360(6392), 987-992.
sources.lifecycle_boundary: Supply chain stages in the dataset: land use change, farm, animal feed, processing, transport, retail, packaging, losses. Consumer use and disposal are not included.
sources.methodology: Meta-analysis of ~38,700 farms in 119 countries. Factor = sum of the eight stage columns, kg CO2-equivalent per kg of food product.

products.name: Rice (raw)
limitations: Global value, not India-specific. Indian paddy methane emissions depend on water management and can differ substantially from the global figure.

products.name: Wheat atta
limitations: Global value, not India-specific.
The source category 'Wheat & Rye' groups two grains and its exact product definition (grain, flour or bread) could not be confirmed from the published chart; matched to atta with that uncertainty.

products.name: Jowar (sorghum)
limitations: No sorghum entry in the dataset used. No estimate is shown rather than borrowing another grain's value.

products.name: Bajra (pearl millet)
limitations: No pearl millet entry in the dataset used.

products.name: Ragi (finger millet)
limitations: No finger millet entry in the dataset used.

products.name: Toor dal
limitations: Global 'Other Pulses' category (not pigeon pea specifically), not India-specific.
Splitting/dehusking into dal is not separately modelled.

products.name: Moong dal
limitations: Global 'Other Pulses' category (not mung bean specifically), not India-specific.
Splitting/dehusking into dal is not separately modelled.

products.name: Chana dal
limitations: Global 'Other Pulses' category (not chickpea specifically), not India-specific.

products.name: Masoor dal
limitations: Global 'Other Pulses' category (not lentil specifically), not India-specific.

products.name: Rajma (kidney beans)
limitations: Global 'Other Pulses' category, not India-specific.

products.name: Milk
limitations: Global value (largely cow milk), not India-specific; Indian milk includes a large share of buffalo milk with different emissions.
Converted from litres at 1.03 kg per litre (typical milk density).

products.name: Curd (dahi)
limitations: The dataset has no curd/yoghurt entry. Using the milk value would ignore processing and is not done.

products.name: Paneer
limitations: The dataset's 'Cheese' entry reflects ripened cheeses with different milk-per-kg and processing; it is not used for paneer.

products.name: Potato
limitations: Global value, not India-specific.

products.name: Tomato
limitations: Global value includes heated-greenhouse production common in colder countries; Indian open-field tomatoes are likely lower. The direction of the error is known, its size is not.

products.name: Onion
limitations: Global 'Onions & Leeks' category, not India-specific.

products.name: Cauliflower
limitations: Global 'Brassicas' category (cabbage family), not cauliflower-specific or India-specific.

products.name: Spinach (palak)
limitations: Matched to the broad 'Other Vegetables' category only; weak product match.

products.name: Banana
limitations: Global value; transport share reflects export bananas, while Indian bananas are mostly sold domestically.

products.name: Apple
limitations: Global value, not India-specific.

products.name: Orange
limitations: Global 'Citrus Fruit' category, not India-specific.

products.name: Sugar
limitations: Global cane sugar value, not India-specific.

products.name: Groundnuts (peanuts)
limitations: Global value, not India-specific.

products.name: Sunflower oil
limitations: Global value, not India-specific.
Converted from litres at 0.92 kg per litre (typical oil density).

products.name: Tea leaves
limitations: The dataset has no tea entry.

alternatives.note: Grains are not nutritionally identical; this compares estimated emissions per kg only.
NOT a substitute: different culinary role. Kept here to test that non-comparable pairs are rejected.
